findings.label: Change key vs bucketed glyph in the temperature section
findings.detail: lead-temperature-section.tsx passes changeKey={current} (raw lead.leadNature) while rendering temperatureGlyph(level) (bucketed). A raw-value change that maps to the same temperature bucket will pop an unchanged emoji. Cosmetic and arguably correct; no action required. The table path aligns key and glyph on the same raw value, so it is unaffected.
